graph_scope: exact scratchpad read-from and overwrite ancestry; canonical machine-state dependencies remain implicit in iteration order

source_version.0: the initial zero value of the addressed scratchpad word
source_version.positive: the one-based global write generation that last wrote the addressed word

canonical_encoding.domain: Soveroot/PowResearch/VersionedGraph/v1 followed by a zero byte
canonical_encoding.header: domain, word_count u64, mix_iterations u64, final_sample_words u64
canonical_encoding.read_edge: tag 0 u8, consumer_kind u8, consumer_ordinal u64, slot u8, word u64, source_version u64
canonical_encoding.write_version: tag 1 u8, version u64, producer_iteration u64, slot u8, word u64, prior_version u64
canonical_encoding.commitment: SHA3-384 of the complete canonical encoding

packed.interpretation: optimistic aligned lower-bound representation under the current research envelope

conservative.interpretation: all semantic fields charged as 64-bit values

limitations: the canonical evaluator retains the complete scratchpad
the graph is derived after following value-dependent addresses
the graph commitment does not make future edges available to an online miner
logical byte layouts do not measure allocator overhead or process resident memory
the graph does not recompute a missing value or produce a reduced-memory proof
no proof-of-work evaluation gate is assessed
next_use: input to offline pebbling lower-bound research and schedule design; never executable attack evidence by itself
